answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bonded stakes, not identity checks. Each agent identity must lock a bond that only that identity can reclaim by having its work verified, so spawning a thousand puppets costs a thousand locked stakes. Each bond is a relic pinning profit to one key, so a farmer cannot move earnings between clones and any slash drains whichever clone misbehaved. New identities also stand on a steep ledge: reputation starts at zero, so a fresh swarm can only whisper into an empty room until it burns time and capital climbing. Cost of attack: capital locked per clone plus idle time.
